name: Boiler controls and oxygen trim
description: Control system that holds the fuel-to-air ratio and steam conditions across load. A stand-alone PLC oxygen-trim package uses an O2 sensor, firing-rate sensor and actuator or variable-speed drive to compensate for temperature, barometric pressure and fuel changes; package burners add parallel positioning, remote monitoring and burner-management interlocks.
